title: Keep constructor normalization out of the shared interval conversion helper
answers: Where should non-interval extension arrays be converted to numpy arrays?
Why must from_breaks preserve extension-array breaks?
body:
Constructor-specific ndarray normalization belongs in pandas/core/arrays/interval.py:IntervalArray.__new__.
The shared pandas/core/arrays/interval.py:_maybe_convert_platform_interval also serves from_breaks, which must keep extension-array breaks intact.
Moving this normalization into the shared helper would violate that preservation requirement; retain the constructor boundary when fixing interval-input parsing.
applies: Changes to interval input normalization that could affect both direct construction and from_breaks.
